excerpt: created in 1988 when EIR (Eidgenossisches Institut fur Reaktorforschung, Swiss Federal Institute for Reactor Research, founded in 1960) was merged with SIN. PSI belongs to the ETH Domain of the Swiss Confederation. Located in the Canton of Aargau in the municipalities Villigen and Wurenlingen, coordinates 47.53611 N 8.22278 E. HIPA energy: 590 MeV. The 1.3 MW strong proton beam is directed towards the muon source (SmuS) and the spallation neutron source (SINQ).
